sources.sentence: Her marking spilled well beyond school hours.

brief.meaningEn: An effect, skill, benefit or pressure can extend from one domain into another; a work duty can also continue beyond its scheduled school or working hours. Name the boundary actually crossed. Marking done after school does not by itself prove an effect on family life.
brief.meaningZh: 影響、技能、好處或壓力可由一個範疇延伸到另一個；工作亦可超出原定的上課或工作時間。須指出實際跨越了哪道界線；放學後批改不必然證明家庭生活受影響。
brief.grammar: An effect, skill, benefit, pressure or work demand spills into + an affected domain. A named duty such as marking spills (well) beyond school or working hours when it continues after that time boundary. Has spilled into marks an observed domain effect; may spill into predicts one. Do not infer a second domain effect from overtime alone.
brief.register: Everyday to journalistic figurative description: a student may show a classroom skill reaching a community project, while a teacher may report marking continuing past school hours without claiming that family plans changed.
brief.boundaryZh: 可指出影響跨越生活或工作範疇，也可指出一項工作超出原定時間。須有具體的另一範疇或時間界線；放學後仍批改，不等於已知家庭活動受影響。真的打翻液體亦不是本課比喻。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把可能的影響說成已發生，也不要因工作超時便臆測家庭活動取消；兩種情況都要按已知證據描述。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出技能或問題延伸到另一範疇，或工作超出哪段原定時間，並區分已見到的越界與未證實的後果。

listening.en: Mara’s work rota changed three times this week. She began answering shift messages during family dinner, so the scheduling pressure was spilling into her home time.
listening.zh: Mara 的工作更表本周改了三次。她開始在家庭晚餐時回覆更班訊息，因此排班壓力正蔓延到她的家庭時間。
listening.promptEn: What boundary has the pressure crossed?
listening.promptZh: 這股壓力跨越了哪個範疇的界線？

options.en: Work scheduling has begun affecting time at home.
options.zh: 工作排班開始影響在家的時間。

options.en: Mara has already resigned from her job.
Her family asked her to take extra shifts.
The rota changes stayed entirely within office hours.
options.zh: 更表變動完全只在辦公時間內產生影響。

listening.explanationZh: 她在家庭晚餐時處理工作訊息，顯示工作壓力延伸到家中時間。

reply.promptEn: My volunteer rota was meant to take two hours a week, but I now answer club messages every Sunday afternoon. How would you respond?
reply.promptZh: 我本來每周只需花兩小時處理義工更表，但現在每逢周日下午都要回覆學會訊息。你會怎樣回應？

options.en: It sounds as if the club work is spilling into your rest time.
options.zh: 聽起來學會工作正蔓延到你的休息時間。

options.en: You could agree with the team on a fixed time for replies.
options.zh: 你可以跟團隊協議一個固定回覆時段。

options.en: That seems to take more of your weekend than the rota allowed.
options.zh: 這似乎佔用你周末的時間，比原定更表多。

options.en: Perhaps another volunteer could share the messages on Sundays.
options.zh: 也許另一名義工可分擔周日的訊息。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都合理回應周日時間被佔用的情況；金句用 spill into 表達工作影響休息。

scene.promptZh: 學生在數學課學會比較單位價格；後來替社區花園採購材料時，他們實際用這方法比較兩家店的報價。哪句最有根據？

options.en: The classroom skill spilled into the community garden’s purchasing decisions.
options.zh: 課堂學到的技能延伸到社區花園的採購決定中。

options.en: The garden purchases taught the students unit pricing before the maths class did.
options.zh: 花園採購比數學課更早教會學生比較單位價格。

options.en: The maths lesson remained entirely within the classroom and never affected the purchases.
options.zh: 數學課所學完全留在課堂裏，沒有影響採購。

scene.explanationZh: 學生先在課堂學會比較單位價格，後來在社區採購時實際使用；另兩句倒置先後或否認已發生的延伸。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最沒有顯示問題 spill into 另一範疇？

options.en: A shop’s staffing gap forces a parent to miss a child’s pickup.
options.zh: 商店人手不足令一名家長錯過接孩子的時間。

options.en: A rehearsal overrun delays the chess club’s room booking.
options.zh: 排練超時令棋藝會使用房間的時間延後。

options.en: A school deadline is handled entirely during class hours, with no effect on activities afterward.
options.zh: 學校限期完全在上課時間內處理，沒有影響之後的活動。

contrast.explanationZh: 限期的影響沒有延伸出原本課堂；前兩例都跨越了活動範疇。

dialogue.promptZh: 甲說：「學校下午四點結束上課。周老師原本打算在校內批完作文，但這星期連續兩晚仍在家批改到九點。題目沒有提及家庭活動是否受影響。」乙要描述批改時間，哪句最有根據？

options.en: The essay marking spilled well beyond school hours; she continued it at home on two evenings.
options.zh: 作文批改延伸到上課時間以外；她連續兩晚仍在家繼續批改。

options.en: Only the journey home happened after four; all the essay marking was finished at school.
options.zh: 只有回家路程發生在四點後；所有作文都已在校內批改完畢。

options.en: The evening marking proves that she cancelled family plans to finish the essays.
options.zh: 晚上批改證明她為了完成作文而取消了家庭活動。

dialogue.explanationZh: 連續兩晚在家批改至九點，證明作文批改超出上課時間；題目沒有證據說她取消了家庭活動。

speaking.en: The delayed permit is spilling into the community workshop schedule: volunteers cannot open the room on Saturday.
speaking.zh: 許可證延誤正影響社區工作坊的日程：義工周六無法開放場地。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出問題從哪裏擴散到哪個安排。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社區體育館的新報名系統在周一和周二出錯。兩名義工周三晚上要手動核對預約，因此錯過原定的培訓；系統何時修好仍未確定。用一至兩句英文說明問題如何跨越到義工的晚上安排，不要說系統已修好。
writing.selfCheckZh: 兩例都寫出周一及周二的報名問題、兩名義工周三晚手動核對預約而錯過培訓，以及修復時間未定。

examples.en: The Monday and Tuesday booking errors have spilled into the volunteers’ Wednesday evening: two people checked reservations by hand and missed training, while the repair date remains unknown.
examples.zh: 周一和周二的預約錯誤已影響義工的周三晚上：兩人手動核對預約而錯過培訓，系統修復日期仍未確定。

examples.en: Because the new system failed on Monday and Tuesday, the problem spilled into Wednesday evening training: two volunteers had to check bookings manually and could not attend; no repair date is confirmed.
examples.zh: 因新系統在周一和周二出錯，問題蔓延到周三晚的培訓：兩名義工須手動核對預約而無法出席；修復日期仍未確定。

glossary.zh: 周一和周二的預約錯誤

takeaways.en: When a problem spills into another part of life, its effects cross an identifiable boundary.
takeaways.zh: 問題 spill into 另一生活範疇，表示影響跨越了清楚可辨的界線。

takeaways.en: A skill learned in class can spill into a community project when students put it to use there.
takeaways.zh: 學生把課堂技能用於社區計劃時，所學便能延伸到課堂以外。
